scripts.types: bunx --bun --no-install civet --config civet.types.json --emit-declaration src/schema/index.civet src/server/client.civet src/server/migration.civet src/server/repositories.civet src/reset.civet src/seeds/users.civet src/seeds/content.civet src/seeds/preferences.civet src/seeds/profiles.civet src/seeds/index.civet src/server/index.civet
scripts.test: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit src/server/boundary.test.civet src/server/server-bundle.test.civet src/server/client.test.civet src/server/repositories.test.civet --exclude "**/*contract.test.civet"
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --project unit src/server/boundary.test.civet src/server/server-bundle.test.civet src/server/client.test.civet src/server/repositories.test.civet --exclude "**/*contract.test.civet"
scripts.db:schema: bunx --bun --no-install civet --compile src/schema/index.civet --output .drizzle/src/schema/index.ts && bunx --bun --no-install civet --compile src/generated/schema-registry.civet --output .drizzle/src/generated/schema-registry.ts
scripts.db:generate: bun run db:schema && bunx --bun --no-install drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:check: bun run db:schema && bunx --bun --no-install drizzle-kit check --config drizzle.config.ts
scripts.db:migrate: bun run db:schema && bunx --bun --no-install drizzle-kit migrate --config drizzle.config.ts
